title: Machine-learning feature selection nominates GUCA2B as a colorectal cancer biomarker
summary: Four ML algorithms selected features from 850 downregulated genes, giving a frozen eight-gene logistic model that included GUCA2B. Its apparent AUC was 0.998 in TCGA-COADREAD (training) and 0.881-0.974 in three independent cohorts. Restoring GUCA2B in HCT-116 cells induced apoptosis and reduced viability and migration, but the authors note the receptor mechanism was untested.
ai_technology: Consensus feature selection across four ML algorithms and a logistic signature model
organization: Hamedan University of Medical Sciences; Isfahan University of Medical Sciences

evidence.tested: Three independent cohorts and in vitro functional assays in one cell line.
evidence.unknown: Small discovery set (n = 23); training AUC is apparent; one cell line; candidate only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML selected the gene signature and GUCA2B.
